name: Announcement bar
description: A full-width top strip carrying one shipping or offer message, with an optional link and a dismiss button.

name: Promo banner
description: A larger dismissible in-page banner: headline, supporting line and one call to action, composed as a full accent band.

name: Full moon countdown
description: A message wired to a live ticking countdown in days, hours, minutes and seconds, plus the state it falls back to once the moment passes.

name: Value proposition strip
description: A four-up icon row for the promises a store repeats sitewide.

name: Review summary
description: Average score, star row, total count and a five-bar distribution with percentages, beside a write-a-review call to action.

name: Review list
description: Individual reviews with author, verified-buyer badge, date, rating, title, body, purchased variant, customer photos and a helpful counter.

name: Write a review form
description: A keyboard-operable star input built from radios, with title, body, a photo upload control and a consent checkbox.

name: Customer photo gallery
description: A user-generated photo grid where each tile shows a customer handle and a shop tag, opening in a dialog lightbox.

name: Trust and payment row
description: Accepted payment methods drawn as neutral wordmark labels, beside the security and business reassurances.

name: Gift options
description: A gift-wrap toggle with its price, a gift message with a character counter, and a hide-prices-on-the-packing-slip checkbox.

name: Back in stock
description: An out-of-stock notice with an email capture, its success state, and a line explaining what the alert does.

name: Newsletter capture
description: A signup headline, email field and consent line, swapping to a success state that reveals a key line with a copy button.

name: Recently viewed rail
description: A compact horizontally scrollable rail of previously viewed items, with a clear-history action and an empty state.

name: Editorial band
description: A lookbook band for a story-led store: large image wash, eyebrow, headline, paragraph and a shop-the-story call to action.
